name: short-merged
original: How: She stopped. She knew how. It was the thing that Coombe had made them do: a count aloud, and a cut on the and, and somebody kept free to keep the count. She could write that. She could not write who.

name: ledger-spelled
original: "Thursday the 12th. The Pit, the Marshal's floor. Four heads at 1.0: 4.0, to the Board. A Flask: a string of three on end with a skin, and a lodger. Three bags, the Board's. Pryce, a wall and a walk and a cord, 0.22. Talley, three cuts and a lodger, 0.14. Cade, two stances, 0.08. Rowan, two stances and a stand, off her own thimble. Spent, 4.44. Licensed, in our own right; one remark." He did it twice in the margin. "Held, three and twenty-four. That's from seven and sixty-eight."
text: "Thursday the twelfth. The Pit, the Marshal's floor. Four heads at one point zero: four point zero, to the Board. A Flask: a string of three on end with a skin, and a lodger. Three bags, the Board's. Pryce, a wall and a walk and a cord, zero point two two. Talley, three cuts and a lodger, zero point one four. Cade, two stances, zero point zero eight. Rowan, two stances and a stand, off her own thimble. Spent, four point four four. Licensed, in our own right; one remark." He did it twice in the margin. "Held, three and twenty-four. That's from seven and sixty-eight."
